source.quote: SMSL's own page for the DS100, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « Cirrus Logic's latest audio decoder chip CS43131, with carefully designed circuitry,achieves an unprecedented 0.00017% (-115dB) distortion performance! »; « The new third generation XMOS XU-316, PCM support up to 32bit /768kHz,DSD support up to DSD256. »; « All input ports support MQA and DSD, Coaxial and Optical support DoP64. »

facts.chip: Cirrus Logic CS43131, XMOS XU-316 on USB.

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_optical_has_DoP64_and_no_rate: Optical and coaxial get DoP64 from the maker's own clause and no PCM ceiling, because none is stated: copying 768 kHz onto optical is the error vocabulary/why-the-optical-default-stays-low.json exists to prevent.
